clue.text: Paints and embroiders

definitions.meaning: to paint something is to give it colour
to embroider a story is to embellish it, to add colour to it

explanation.surface: A description of someone's needlework and painting hobbies.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are verbs: to tint with pigment, and to exaggerate or embellish an account.

clue.text: Show progress? Don't exaggerate!

definitions.meaning: a phrase urging someone to get moving, to make progress
an exclamation of disbelief, like saying be serious

explanation.surface: Two exclamations from an impatient listener.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both an urging to hurry along and a scoffing retort to a tall tale.

clue.text: Craft project

definitions.meaning: a large motorboat is a vessel, a craft

explanation.surface: A craft project, like a model kit.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a noun for a motorboat and a verb meaning to propel or set going.

clue.text: One taking part in an emergency

definitions.text: One taking part in an emergency

parts.words: One taking part in an emergency
parts.note: reads like a rescue worker, but means an actor who takes over a role when the lead cannot go on

explanation.surface: Someone helping out in a crisis.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in actor learns a role so as to take the part in an emergency.

clue.text: Is climbing in a rough mountainous area

indicators.note: in a down entry climbing means going upwards, so the word is read backwards
rough means roughly made, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone is climbing in a rugged mountainous region.
explanation.walkthrough: 'climbing' turns IS into SI; 'rough' rearranges IN A into NAI.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula between Africa and Asia is mountainous, home of the biblical mountain.

clue.text: Elegance given a trial in Illinois

parts.note: chic is stylish elegance
a go is a try or attempt

explanation.surface: Someone stylish is being tried out somewhere in the American Midwest.
explanation.definitionFit: The city is the largest place in the state of Illinois, so a city located there fits.

clue.text: The French Revolution

parts.note: read not as the 1789 uprising but as a French term for a sudden overthrow of government

explanation.surface: A reference to the historic 1789 uprising.
explanation.definitionFit: The French phrase for a sudden seizure of power is a revolution expressed in French.

clue.text: Flag raised in the garden

parts.note: reads like a banner on a pole, but flag is a name for a plant grown in flower beds

explanation.surface: Someone running up a flag in their garden.
explanation.definitionFit: The yellow flag is a kind of this plant, which gardeners grow.

clue.text: Attachment had noise coming from it

indicators.note: the answer comes out of these letters by rearranging them

explanation.surface: A clinging attachment that made a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Adhesion is the act of sticking to something, an attachment.

clue.text: Rode around the circus giving commands

indicators.note: around suggests going about in a different way, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the ring is the circus arena

explanation.surface: A ringmaster riding round the circus barking orders.
explanation.definitionFit: Ordering people about is issuing commands to them.

clue.text: Churned up mud on a small hill

indicators.note: churning stirs things around, so the letters that follow are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: Mud churned up on a little hillock.
explanation.definitionFit: A mound is a low rounded heap or hillock of earth, a synonym for a small hill.

clue.text: Well-fed, he is round in form

indicators.note: the words are put into a new shape or form, signalling that their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A plump man is described as being round in shape, clearly well fed.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean properly supplied with food, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Big worry about angry writer

parts.note: OS is the abbreviation for outsize, a clothing size

indicators.note: about means going round, so one word is placed around the other

parts.note: care is anxiety or worry
wild means furious, angry

explanation.surface: A writer is greatly worried and angry.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Big' looks like an adjective for the worry, but it gives the clothing-size abbreviation; the definition 'writer' points to the Irish author of The Importance of Being Earnest.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish playwright and novelist was a famous author, so he is an example of a writer.

clue.text: In retreat, a holy man leads king and emperor

indicators.note: leads means goes in front of the next piece
retreating means going backwards, so the letters are read in reverse order

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for saint
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A holy man in retreat walks ahead of a king and an emperor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In retreat' turns A + ST into TSA, which then goes before R.
explanation.definitionFit: The title was used by the Russian emperors, so it is a specific word for emperor.

clue.text: Musical lady happy to be on her own?

definitions.text: Musical lady happy to be on her own?

parts.words: Musical lady happy to be on her own?
parts.note: a cheerful woman who has lost her husband, also the title of a Lehar operetta

explanation.surface: A jolly woman who enjoys singing and solitude.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lehar operetta's title describes a cheerful woman whose husband has died.

clue.text: Sadly lost the wind, it is very light

indicators.note: sadly suggests something gone wrong, so the letters are jumbled into a new order

explanation.surface: A lament that the breeze has dropped, said of something very light that floats on it.
explanation.definitionFit: The fluffy seed tufts of thistles are so weightless they drift on the slightest breeze, a byword for lightness.

clue.text: Puck gets the push in this

definitions.text: Puck gets the push in this

parts.words: Puck gets the push in this
parts.note: reads like Shakespeare's sprite being dismissed, but puck is the disc pushed with a stick in a winter sport

explanation.surface: The mischievous sprite of A Midsummer Night's Dream is dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: In this sport players push a rubber puck across a rink with sticks.

clue.text: Scanning the books for money owing on the horses

indicators.note: in a down entry on means placed below the other piece

parts.note: a stud is a stable of breeding horses
IOUs are notes acknowledging money owed

explanation.surface: A gambler pores over the accounts to see what is owed on bets.
explanation.definitionFit: Being studious means poring over books, so the definition describes the activity of such a person.

clue.text: A double first

parts.note: reads like a top degree in two subjects, but means a race where two finish first together

explanation.surface: A top university honour in two subjects.
explanation.definitionFit: In a race tie two competitors both come first, a double first place.

clue.text: Course followed by bird dog first in the field

indicators.note: followed by means the second piece comes after the first

parts.note: a trend is a general course or direction
a setter is a gun dog used to find game birds

explanation.surface: A hunting scene: a dog follows a course and is first into the field.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who sets fashions leads the way, being the first to do something in a given field.

clue.text: Go over undulating track

indicators.note: undulating means moving in waves, so the letters shift into a new order

explanation.surface: An instruction to cross a wavy track.
explanation.definitionFit: A groove is a channel or track, as on a record.

clue.text: The Spanish man comes first in place of worship

indicators.note: comes first means this piece goes before the other

parts.note: chap is an informal word for man
el is the Spanish word for the

explanation.surface: A Spaniard goes ahead into church.
explanation.definitionFit: A chapel is a small church, a place of worship.

clue.text: Prepare and serve a bird, none now left

parts.note: to do food is to prepare or cook it
to do a customer is to serve them

explanation.surface: Cooking and serving a bird that is extinct, a culinary impossibility.
explanation.definitionFit: The flightless Mauritian bird died out in the 17th century, so it is an extinct bird.

clue.text: The poet who knew the value of language?

definitions.text: The poet who knew the value of language?

parts.words: The poet who knew the value of language?
parts.note: the name of a Lake District poet split into two words reads as what words are worth

explanation.surface: A tribute to a poet's appreciation of words.
explanation.definitionFit: The English Romantic poet's surname can be read as two words describing the value of language.

clue.text: University teacher or patron

parts.note: a don is a university lecturer, especially at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A choice between an academic and a sponsor.
explanation.definitionFit: A donor gives money in support, as a patron does.

clue.text: It becomes inflamed by the lash

definitions.text: It becomes inflamed by the lash

parts.words: It becomes inflamed by the lash
parts.note: reads like a wound from a whip, but lash means eyelash, beside which a swelling forms

explanation.surface: A whipping leaves a swollen weal.
explanation.definitionFit: A swelling on the eyelid forms at the base of an eyelash.

clue.text: Caught and bowled

definitions.meaning: caught in the sense of caught up with and passed
in cricket a bowled over is an ..., read as two words

explanation.surface: Two ways a cricket batter can be dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled; read as two words the answer means a set that has been bowled.
explanation.definitionFit: Overtaken means caught up and passed; split in two it describes an over that has been delivered.

clue.text: Fall out of love and decline

indicators.note: the first word stands outside the next, so it goes round it

parts.note: to drop is to fall
O is a zero score, love in tennis

explanation.surface: Falling out of love and going into decline.
explanation.definitionFit: Both mean to sag or sink and lose vigour, a synonym of decline as a verb.

clue.text: Yet it's a misplaced feeling of gratification

indicators.note: misplaced means put in the wrong position, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A feeling of satisfaction that turns out to be unwarranted.
explanation.definitionFit: Satiety is the state of being fully satisfied, a sense of gratification.

clue.text: Rough treatment for unseasoned wood

parts.note: raw means untreated, as timber that is not seasoned
deal is fir or pine timber

explanation.surface: A carpenter given green timber feels badly treated.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for unfair or harsh treatment, matching rough treatment.
